verdict.rationale: Asana's own documentation describes AI Studio as "powerful no-code automations" and references native Rules with rule actions, including Rules that trigger actions such as creating PagerDuty incidents. That establishes first-party no-code automation, but nothing shows how multi-step workflows are built or chained. Third-party tools like Zapier, n8n and Pipedream are external workarounds and earn no credit. missing for 10: documentation of multi-step rule/workflow building (triggers, conditions, chained actions), detail on AI Studio's workflow builder, independent or hands-on corroboration.
